messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] billing-metering anomaly detected — token_count_service reported +480% delta vs baseline in last 5m. Pager: P1. Affected services: ingest-token-agg, usage-emitter. Runbook: /runbooks/billing-anomaly.

sasha: Oncall SRE here, taking this. Joining now.

opsbot: Deploy log: emitter service v3.2.1 rolled at 2026-03-17T09:12:08Z — correlated with spike.

kevin: Looking at consumer/producer stats — kafka topic "usage-events" consumer lag jumped from ~0 to ~400k shortly after deploy. Possible retry loop double-ingest.

billing-eng: We see delayed batch writes to billing-db; flush failures around 09:10-09:28 UTC. Some windows didn't reconcile, which left transient overage flags queued. Affected region: eu-west-1.

sasha: Can you paste a quick query sample for the token deltas?

kevin: Quick check:
```
SELECT window_start, count_tokens, emitter_id, batch_id
FROM token_counts
WHERE window_start > now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 10;
```

kevin: Results: emitter_id=emitter-42 shows duplicate rows with same batch_id repeated -> ack not committed -> retries produced dupes.

billing-eng: Confirmed. Idempotency key missing for ~3% of batches starting at 2026-03-17T09:10Z due to a regression in emitter write path. That caused counts to overreport until window reconciliation ran.

laura: Support: we have 2 customer tickets reporting unexpected overage alerts: CUST-912, CUST-1011. Adding them to incident channel.

sasha: Triage plan: 1) Pause emitter retries for emitter-42 (manual toggle) 2) Kick a backfill job to reconcile affected windows 3) Notify customers with an "we're investigating" message and ETA.

kevin: Pausing retries now: `/emitter toggle-retries emitter-42 --off` -> success.

opsbot: Action logged: feature-toggle emitter.retries.emitter-42=false by kevin at 4360001250.

billing-eng: Launching backfill: `backfill-token-windows --from 2026-03-17T09:05Z --to 2026-03-17T09:30Z`. ETA ~45m. Will stream progress here.

sasha: Did the automated overage flaging run during the anomaly window?

billing-eng: Yes — the anomaly overlapped the daily threshold check at ~09:15 UTC; automated rules fired for a small subset of accounts. We'll retract false flags once backfill completes and counts reconcile.

laura: Drafting short customer message: "We're aware of inflated usage alerts for some customers in EU; investigating, will update within 1h." Wait for final reconciliation before billing changes?

sasha: Send the "we're aware" now with ETA; follow up with final outcome when reconciliation completes.

maria: Product note: include sentence "No billing charges will be applied until reconciliation completes." avoids confusion.

billing-eng: Backfill progress: processed 6/25 windows (12/100 shards). Preliminary net delta shows -0.9% vs emitted counts. Streaming job logs to s3://redwood-billing/backfill/4360001111.log

sasha: Oncall plan: I'll stay on for next 90m and verify stability, then hand to kevin if still open. Postmortem items: enforce idempotency key checks, add emitter retry safety throttle, improve monitoring for duplicate batch_ids.

laura: Added CUST-912 & CUST-1011 to notification list and created support follow-ups. Template saved as /support/templates/billing-anomaly-4360001111.md

opsbot: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4360001111 — external status: investigating.

kevin: After toggling retries, consumer lag is decreasing. Current lag ~12k and trending down. No new duplicate batch_ids observed.

billing-eng: Backfill complete. Reconciliation job finished; automated overage flags retracted at 4360001389. Final reconciliation report uploaded to s3://redwood-billing/reports/4360001111-recon.json. Net change after dedupe: -1.02% of tokens for the window.

sasha: Actions/next steps: 1) Patch PR created: github.com/redwood/billing/pull/482 (enforce idempotency key) 2) Schedule canary for emitter write path 3) Customer follow-ups queued for when support confirms. I'll mark resolved after 1h of stable metrics.

laura: Thanks all — sending the customer "we're aware" notice now and will follow up with the reconciliation note. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Incident current status: mitigated. Will transition to postmortem tracking.

kevin: Consumer lag back to normal. Monitoring steady.

billing-eng: Patch merged to main, rolling to canary. We'll keep monitoring for 1h.

sasha: Closing note: Good run. Postmortem assigned to billing-eng + eng-infra. I'll open the postmortem doc and link the timeline.

laura: Closing customer loop: follow-ups scheduled.

maria: Please include a brief blameless summary for execs: root cause = missing idempotency keys + retry loop; mitigation = paused emitter retries + backfill + idempotency enforcement patch.

sasha: Agreed. Incident channel archived once postmortem created.
